integrity: The full stand-alone C++ source is supplied. It implements finite-state BFS with shortest-walk counting and independent overlap-tour dynamic programming, with direct cyclic witness checking. No independently performed scientific audit or third-party certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification only for m=1..4; counts index the cycle at a specified required first word. No extrapolation beyond length eight. A closely related publisher full text was partially available and could not be independently retrieved in full.
title: Exact shortest cyclic covers of binary reverse-complement palindromes through length eight
